topics.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to a surge in fraudulent activities, with many cases involving government relief programs. Recent allegations against Rep. Ilhan Omar have brought attention to the issue.
topics.reason: New allegations surface against Rep. Ilhan Omar

topics.description: Minnesota has seen a significant number of fraud cases, including a $250M COVID-19 meal fraud scheme. The state's attorney general's office is investigating various cases.
topics.reason: Minnesota Attorney General’s fraud unit expects funding boost
